title: TMax
input: Upstream domain/skill/fixture sampling configuration and base-image recipes.
native_output: Apptainer task bundles, fixtures and optional sampled solution summaries.

execution.runtime: VM sandbox with Docker and Apptainer

conversion.approach: Use its existing Harbor converter; preserve the generated tests and task semantics.

deviations: Fix nullable metadata serialization; provider-compatible required tool calls in solver.
Separate generated-task runtime repair adds a missing verifier dependency.
known_limitations: The upstream method skips teacher correctness validation and its converter omits solve.sh. Record missing reference evidence; do not silently add a new oracle-generation stage.

why_this_order: Reuse the Apptainer runtime established for Endless, then exercise the richer sampler and fixtures.
